The Boost footswitch engages a dedicated section of the circuit, separately tuned to hit the front end of the Red Muck and generate even fatter walls of Fuzz-Distortion or with the Gain set lower, function as a High-Gain-Stage footswitch. The boost side engages a different circuitthat can handle all the great sounds with the gain turned down or up. Highly usable in a ton of settings as the pedal cleans up great with the volume knob, with a tone that sits excellently in the mix. Whether it’s stoner doom or Gilmour-ish sustain, this red box has the saturation covered.Jam Pedals are hand-painted and vary slightly in appearance.
